user.title: SolarEdge Cloud (API v2)
user.description:
Create a **Site Access** application on [developer.solaredge.com]({developer_portal_url}) with the scopes SITE_DATA and DEVICE_DATA, and register this exact redirect URL:

`{redirect_uri}`

Home Assistant must be reachable on that address over https (for example through Home Assistant Cloud or a reverse proxy). After submitting, SolarEdge opens a window: sign in with the site owner's account and grant access.

data_description.site_id: Shown in the SolarEdge monitoring portal or app (site details).
data_description.client_secret: From your Site Access application. Only shown once when the app is created.

progress.auth: Grant access in the SolarEdge window that just opened.
